NequIP's internal features are equivariant to rotations and reflections, so the relevant group is O(3). The network's output energy is invariant under translations, reflections, and rotations [W4225405705#005]. NequIP is described as an E(3)-equivariant model whose internal features are equivariant with respect to the 3D Euclidean group, built using only E(3)-equivariant operations [W4319162181#003].
